items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: I'm talking about George or something. I could get his name, too, because I know different people.

ctx.x: Yes. Well, I've heard of him. I think Pete Ducanger is still alive. Oh, he ought to know. Huh? I think Pete Ducanger, the piano player, is still alive, but I haven't seen him.

Oh, yeah, I think so. But Adolph got killed, uh, he was a shoemaker. And he'd go along picking up shoes down the country, and he got killed somewhere, automobile right? You ought to remember, because that ain't been too long when Adolph got killed. You know, he was always good size. But anyway, and then he had, uh, let's see, when he played at the Cadillac, after when he took Adolph, before he had Adolph, he had, uh, George, uh, George, he went to Chicago. George, what was his name? I often hear his name called…
